verses.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.modern: This is the book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

verses.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.modern: Abraham begat Isaac, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Judas and his brothers.

verses.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.modern: Judas begat Phares and Zara by Thamar; Phares begat Esrom; Esrom begat Aram.

verses.kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.modern: Aram begat Aminadab; Aminadab begat Naasson; Naasson begat Salmon.

verses.kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.modern: Salmon begat Booz by Rachab; Booz begat Obed by Ruth; Obed begat Jesse.

verses.kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
verses.modern: Jesse begat David the king; David the king begat Solomon by her who had been the wife of Urias.

verses.kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.modern: Solomon begat Roboam; Roboam begat Abia; Abia begat Asa.

verses.kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.modern: Asa begat Josaphat; Josaphat begat Joram; Joram begat Ozias.

verses.kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.modern: Ozias begat Joatham; Joatham begat Achaz; Achaz begat Ezekias.

verses.kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.modern: Ezekias begat Manasses; Manasses begat Amon; Amon begat Josias.

verses.kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.modern: Josias begat Jechonias and his brothers, around the time they were carried away to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.modern: After they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; Salathiel begat Zorobabel.

verses.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.modern: Zorobabel begat Abiud; Abiud begat Eliakim; Eliakim begat Azor.

verses.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.modern: Azor begat Sadoc; Sadoc begat Achim; Achim begat Eliud.

verses.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.modern: Eliud begat Eleazar; Eleazar begat Matthan; Matthan begat Jacob.

verses.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.modern: Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, Who is called Christ.

verses.kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.modern: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations. From David to the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations. From the carrying away into Babylon to Christ are fourteen generations.

verses.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about. His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph. Before they came together, she was found to be with child by the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.modern: Joseph her husband was a righteous man. He did not want to disgrace her publicly, so he decided to divorce her quietly.

verses.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: While He was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to Him in a dream. The angel said, "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. What is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.modern: She will give birth to a son, and you shall call His name JESUS, for He will save His people from their sins."

verses.kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet:

verses.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.modern: "A virgin shall be with child and will give birth to a son. They shall call His name Emmanuel" — which means, God with us.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.modern: Joseph woke from sleep and did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him. He took Mary as his wife.

verses.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
verses.modern: He did not come together with her until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He called His name JESUS.

chapters.summary: Matthew traces the genealogy of Jesus Christ from Abraham through David to Joseph. An angel appears to Joseph in a dream, telling him that Mary's child is conceived by the Holy Ghost and that He shall be called JESUS, for He will save His people from their sins.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
verses.modern: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of King Herod. Wise men from the east came to Jerusalem

verses.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.modern: and asked, "Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship Him."

verses.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.modern: When King Herod heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

verses.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
verses.modern: He gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people and asked them where Christ was to be born.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
verses.modern: They told him, "In Bethlehem of Judaea, for so it is written by the prophet:

verses.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
verses.modern: 'And you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah. From you shall come a Governor who will shepherd My people Israel.'"

verses.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.modern: Then Herod called the wise men secretly and questioned them carefully about the exact time the star had appeared.

verses.kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.modern: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and search carefully for the young child. When you have found Him, bring word back to me, so that I may come and worship Him also."

verses.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.modern: After they had heard the king, they departed. The star they had seen in the east went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

verses.kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.modern: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great joy.

verses.kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.modern: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary his mother. They fell down and worshipped him. Opening their treasures, they presented Him with gifts — gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

verses.kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.modern: Being warned by God in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country by another route.

verses.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.modern: After they had departed, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. The angel said, "Get up, take the young child and his mother, and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him."

verses.kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
verses.modern: Joseph rose, took the young child and his mother by night, and departed to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
verses.modern: He stayed there until the death of Herod. This was to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I have called My Son."

verses.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
verses.modern: Then Herod, seeing that the wise men had tricked him, was greatly enraged. He sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all its surrounding region, from two years old and under, according to the time he had carefully determined from the wise men.

verses.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: Then was fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet Jeremy:

verses.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.modern: "A voice was heard in Rama — lamentation and weeping and great mourning. Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted, because they are no more."

verses.kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.modern: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

verses.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
verses.modern: and said, "Get up, take the young child and His mother, and go to the land of Israel. Those who sought the young child's life are dead."

verses.kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.modern: Joseph rose, took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

verses.kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.modern: When he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judaea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned by God in a dream, He turned aside to the region of Galilee.

verses.kjv: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
verses.modern: He came and lived in a city called Nazareth. This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophets: "He shall be called a Nazarene."

chapters.summary: Wise men from the east follow a star to find the newborn King in Bethlehem and present Him with gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Herod, enraged at the report of a rival king, orders the slaughter of all male children in Bethlehem, but Joseph flees with Mary and the child to Egypt.

verses.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.modern: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judaea.

verses.kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.modern: He said, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."

verses.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.modern: This is the one spoken of by the prophet Esaias: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way of the Lord, make His paths straight.'"

verses.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.modern: John's clothes were made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

verses.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.modern: Then Jerusalem and all Judaea and all the region around Jordan went out to him.

verses.kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.modern: They were baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.

verses.kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.modern: When he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.modern: Bring forth fruit in keeping with repentance.

verses.kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.modern: Do not think to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' I tell you, God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones.

verses.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.modern: Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
verses.modern: I baptize You with water for repentance. But He who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize You with the Holy Ghost and with fire.

verses.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.modern: His winnowing fork is in His hand. He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor, gathering His wheat into the barn. But the chaff He will burn up with unquenchable fire."

verses.kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.modern: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

verses.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.modern: John tried to stop him, saying, "I need to be baptized by You — and do You come to me?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "Allow it now, for it is right for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then John allowed it.

verses.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.modern: When Jesus was baptized, He went up immediately out of the water. The heavens were opened to Him. He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on Him.

verses.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.modern: A voice from heaven said, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

chapters.summary: John the Baptist preaches repentance in the wilderness of Judaea, baptizing crowds in the Jordan. Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized, and the heavens open as the Spirit descends like a dove and the Father declares, 'This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.'

verses.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.modern: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

verses.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.modern: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.

verses.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.modern: The tempter came to Him and said, "If You are the Son of God, command that these stones be made into bread."

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.'"

verses.kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.modern: Then the devil took him into the holy city and set him on the highest point of the temple.

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down. For it is written: 'He shall give His angels charge over You, and in their hands they shall lift You up, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.'"

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "It is also written: 'You shall not tempt the Lord Your God.'"

verses.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.modern: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "All these things I will give You, if You will fall down and worship me."

verses.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.modern: Then Jesus said to Him, "Away from Me, Satan! For it is written: 'You shall worship the Lord Your God, and Him only shall You serve.'"

verses.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.modern: Then the devil left him. Angels came and ministered to him.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.modern: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he departed to Galilee.

verses.kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.modern: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum by the sea, in the region of Zabulon and Nephthalim.

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Esaias:

verses.kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
verses.modern: "The land of Zabulon and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles —

verses.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.modern: the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light. On those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned."

verses.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.modern: From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."

verses.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.modern: As Jesus was walking along the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers — Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother — casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make You fishers of men."

verses.kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.modern: Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.

verses.kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.modern: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers — James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother — in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. He called them.

verses.kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.modern: Immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed Him.

verses.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.modern: Jesus went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every kind of sickness and every kind of disease among the people.

verses.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.modern: News about Him spread throughout all Syria. They brought to Him all who were sick — those suffering from various diseases and pains, those possessed by demons, those who had seizures, and those who were paralyzed — and He healed them.

verses.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.modern: Large crowds followed Him from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

chapters.summary: The Spirit leads Jesus into the wilderness, where Satan tempts Him three times and Jesus answers each temptation with Scripture. Jesus begins His public ministry in Galilee, calls His first disciples — Simon, Andrew, James, and John — and heals the sick throughout the region.

verses.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.modern: Seeing the crowds, He went up on a mountain. When He sat down, His disciples came to Him.

verses.kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.modern: He opened His mouth and taught them, saying:

verses.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.modern: Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.modern: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.modern: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.modern: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.modern: Blessed are You when men insult You, persecute You, and falsely say all kinds of evil against You for My sake.

verses.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.modern: Rejoice and be greatly glad, for great is Your reward in heaven. In the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before You.

verses.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.modern: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its flavor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything — it is thrown out and trampled underfoot by men.

verses.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.modern: You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.

verses.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.modern: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket, but on a lampstand. It gives light to everyone in the house.

verses.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: Let Your light shine before men in this way, so that they may see Your good works and glorify Your Father who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.modern: Do not think that I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.

verses.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, until heaven and earth pass away, not one jot or one tittle will pass from the Law until all is fulfilled.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: Whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do so will be called least in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever does and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: I tell You that unless Your righteousness surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, You will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.modern: You have heard that it was said to the people of old, 'You shall not murder,' and 'Whoever murders will be in danger of judgment.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.modern: But I tell You that whoever is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of judgment. Whoever says to his brother, 'Raca,' will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, 'You fool,' will be in danger of hell fire.

verses.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.modern: So if You bring Your gift to the altar and there remember that Your brother has something against You,

verses.kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.modern: leave Your gift there before the altar. Go and be reconciled to Your brother first, and then come and offer Your gift.

verses.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.modern: Settle quickly with Your opponent while You are on the way to court with Him. Otherwise He may hand You over to the judge, and the judge to the officer, and You will be thrown into prison.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, You will not get out until You have paid the very last penny.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.modern: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.modern: But I tell You that anyone who looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in His heart.

verses.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.modern: If Your right eye causes You to sin, pluck it out and throw it away. It is better for You that one part of Your body perish than that Your whole body be thrown into hell.

verses.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.modern: If Your right hand causes You to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for You that one part of Your body perish than that Your whole body go into hell.

verses.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.modern: It has been said, 'Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.modern: But I tell You that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, causes her to commit adultery. Whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

verses.kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.modern: Again, You have heard that it was said to the people of old, 'You shall not swear falsely, but shall keep the oaths You made to the Lord.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
verses.modern: But I tell You, do not swear at all — not by heaven, for it is God's throne;

verses.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.modern: not by the earth, for it is His footstool; not by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.modern: Do not swear by Your head, for You cannot make one hair white or black.

verses.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.modern: Let Your word be 'Yes, yes' or 'No, no.' Whatever is more than this comes from evil.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.modern: You have heard that it was said, 'An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.modern: But I tell You, do not resist an evil person. If someone strikes you on your right cheek, turn the other to Him as well.

verses.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
verses.modern: If someone wants to sue you and take your coat, let him have Your cloak as well.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.modern: If someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.

verses.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.modern: Give to the one who asks you. Do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.modern: You have heard that it was said, 'Love Your neighbor and hate Your enemy.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.modern: But I tell You, love Your enemies. Bless those who curse You. Do good to those who hate You. Pray for those who mistreat You and persecute You.

verses.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.modern: This is how You show You are children of Your Father in heaven. He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good. He sends rain on the just and on the unjust.

verses.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.modern: If You love only those who love You, what reward do You have? Even the tax collectors do the same.

verses.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.modern: If You greet only Your brothers, what more are You doing than others? Even the tax collectors do the same.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.modern: Be perfect, therefore, as Your Father in heaven is perfect."

chapters.summary: Jesus delivers the Sermon on the Mount, beginning with the Beatitudes. He teaches about the law, anger, lust, oaths, loving one's enemies, and the calling of His followers to be salt and light in the world.

verses.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: "Be careful not to do Your acts of charity before men in order to be seen by them. If You do, You will have no reward from Your Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.modern: So when You give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before Yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, to receive honor from men. Truly I tell You, they have their reward in full.

verses.kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verses.modern: When You give to the needy, do not let Your left hand know what Your right hand is doing,

verses.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.modern: so that Your giving may be in secret. Your Father who sees in secret will reward You openly.

verses.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.modern: When You pray, do not be like the hypocrites. They love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners, to be seen by men. Truly I tell You, they have their reward in full.

verses.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.modern: But when You pray, go into Your room and shut the door. Pray to Your Father who is in secret. Your Father who sees in secret will reward You openly.

verses.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.modern: When You pray, do not use empty repetition as the heathen do. They think they will be heard because of their many words.

verses.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.modern: Do not be like them, for Your Father knows what You need before You ask Him.

verses.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.modern: Pray in this way: 'Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.

verses.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.modern: Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.modern: Give us this day our daily bread.

verses.kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.modern: Forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

verses.kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.modern: Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.'

verses.kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.modern: If You forgive men their trespasses, Your heavenly Father will also forgive You.

verses.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.modern: But if You do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will Your Father forgive Your trespasses.

verses.kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.modern: When You fast, do not look gloomy like the hypocrites. They put on a sad countenance so that men can see they are fasting. Truly I tell You, they have their reward in full.

verses.kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
verses.modern: When You fast, anoint Your head and wash Your face,

verses.kjv: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.modern: so that You do not appear to men to be fasting, but only to Your Father who is in secret. Your Father who sees in secret will reward You openly.

verses.kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.modern: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

verses.kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.modern: Store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

verses.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.modern: Where Your treasure is, there Your heart will be also.

verses.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.modern: The lamp of the body is the eye. If Your eye is sound, Your whole body will be full of light.

verses.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.modern: But if Your eye is evil, Your whole body will be full of darkness. If the light in You is darkness, how great is that darkness!

verses.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.modern: No one can serve two masters. He will either hate the one and love the other, or He will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.modern: Therefore I tell You, do not be anxious about Your life — what You will eat or what You will drink — or about Your body, what You will put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

verses.kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.modern: Look at the birds of the air. They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, yet Your heavenly Father feeds them. Are You not much more valuable than they?

verses.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.modern: Which of You by worrying can add a single hour to His life?

verses.kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.modern: Why are You anxious about clothes? Consider the lilies of the field — how they grow. They do not toil or spin.

verses.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.modern: Yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.modern: If God so clothes the grass of the field — which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the oven — will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

verses.kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.modern: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, 'What shall we eat?' or 'What shall we drink?' or 'What shall we wear?'

verses.kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.modern: For the Gentiles seek all these things. Your heavenly Father knows that you need all of them.

verses.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.modern: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.

verses.kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.modern: Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious about its own things. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble."

chapters.summary: Jesus continues the Sermon on the Mount, teaching about giving, prayer, and fasting in secret rather than for public display. He teaches the Lord's Prayer and instructs His disciples not to store up treasures on earth but to seek first the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.modern: "Do not judge, so that You will not be judged.

verses.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.modern: With the judgment You use, You will be judged. With the measure You use, it will be measured back to You.

verses.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.modern: Why do You see the speck in Your brother's eye but do not notice the plank in Your own eye?

verses.kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.modern: How can You say to Your brother, 'Let me take the speck out of Your eye,' when there is a plank in Your own eye?

verses.kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
verses.modern: You hypocrite! First take the plank out of Your own eye. Then You will see clearly to remove the speck from Your brother's eye.

verses.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.modern: Do not give what is holy to dogs. Do not throw Your pearls before swine, lest they trample them underfoot and turn and tear You to pieces.

verses.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.modern: Ask, and it will be given to You. Seek, and You will find. Knock, and it will be opened to You.

verses.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.modern: Everyone who asks receives. Everyone who seeks finds. To everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.

verses.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.modern: Which of You, if His son asks for bread, will give Him a stone?

verses.kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.modern: Or if He asks for a fish, will He give Him a snake?

verses.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.modern: If You then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to Your children, how much more will Your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

verses.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.modern: So in everything, do to others what You would have them do to You. This is the Law and the Prophets.

verses.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.modern: Enter through the narrow gate. Wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many go through it.

verses.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.modern: Narrow is the gate and difficult is the way that leads to life, and few find it.

verses.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.modern: Watch out for false prophets. They come to You in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.

verses.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.modern: You will know them by their fruits. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

verses.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.modern: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, and every bad tree bears evil fruit.

verses.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.modern: A good tree cannot bear evil fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

verses.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.modern: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.modern: So You will know them by their fruits.

verses.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: Not everyone who says to Me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of heaven — but only the one who does the will of My Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.modern: Many will say to Me on that day, 'Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons in Your name, and do many mighty works in Your name?'

verses.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.modern: Then I will declare to them, 'I never knew You. Depart from Me, You who practice iniquity.'

verses.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.modern: Everyone who hears these words of Mine and does them will be like a wise man who built His house on the rock.

verses.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.modern: The rain came down, the floods rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house — but it did not fall, because it was built on the rock.

verses.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.modern: Everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not do them will be like a foolish man who built His house on the sand.

verses.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.modern: The rain came down, the floods rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house — and it fell. Great was its fall."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.modern: When Jesus had finished these sayings, the crowds were amazed at His teaching,

verses.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.modern: for He taught them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.

chapters.summary: Jesus concludes the Sermon on the Mount with teaching about judging others, asking and receiving from God, the narrow gate, and recognizing false prophets by their fruits. He closes with the parable of the wise man who built his house on a rock and the foolish man who built on sand.

verses.kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.modern: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.modern: A man with leprosy came and knelt before him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."

verses.kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.modern: Jesus stretched out His hand and touched Him, saying, "I am willing. Be clean." Immediately His leprosy was cleansed.

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "See that You tell no one. Go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."

verses.kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.modern: When Jesus entered Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, pleading with Him,

verses.kjv: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.modern: and saying, "Lord, my servant is lying at home paralyzed and in terrible pain."

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "I will come and heal Him."

verses.kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.modern: The centurion answered, "Lord, I am not worthy for You to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.modern: For I am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, 'Go,' and He goes; to another, 'Come,' and He comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and He does it."

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.modern: When Jesus heard this, He was amazed. He said to those who followed, "Truly I tell You, I have not found such great faith — not even in Israel.

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.modern: Jesus said to the centurion, "Go. Let it be done for you as you have believed." And His servant was healed that very hour.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.modern: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw Peter's mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.

verses.kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.modern: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and began to serve Him.

verses.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.modern: When evening came, they brought to Him many who were possessed with demons. He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick.

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.modern: This was to fulfill what was spoken by Esaias the prophet: "He himself took our infirmities and carried our sicknesses."

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.modern: When Jesus saw large crowds around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side.

verses.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.modern: A certain scribe came and said to Him, "Master, I will follow You wherever You go."

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."

verses.kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.modern: Another of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.modern: But Jesus said to Him, "Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead."

verses.kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.modern: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.modern: Suddenly a great storm arose on the sea, so that the boat was being swamped by the waves. But Jesus was asleep.

verses.kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.modern: His disciples came and woke Him, saying, "Lord, save us! We are perishing!"

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Why are You afraid, O You of little faith?" Then He rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.

verses.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.modern: The men were amazed, saying, "What kind of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him!"

verses.kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.modern: When He arrived on the other side in the country of the Gergesenes, two men possessed with demons came out of the tombs to meet Him. They were so fierce that no one could pass that way.

verses.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.modern: They cried out, "What do You want with us, Jesus, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before the appointed time?"

verses.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.modern: A large herd of pigs was feeding some distance away.

verses.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.modern: The demons begged Him, "If You cast us out, send us into the herd of pigs."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Go." They came out and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the waters.

verses.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.modern: Those tending the pigs ran off, went into the city, and reported everything — including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.modern: The whole city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.

chapters.summary: Jesus heals a leper, the centurion's servant, and Peter's mother-in-law, then casts out demons and heals many who are sick. He calms a violent storm on the sea and drives a legion of demons out of two men in the country of the Gergesenes.

verses.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.modern: Jesus got into the boat, crossed over, and came to His own city.

verses.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.modern: Some men brought to Him a paralyzed man lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralyzed man, "Take courage, son. Your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.modern: Some of the scribes said to themselves, "This man is blaspheming."

verses.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.modern: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, "Why do You think evil in Your hearts?

verses.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.modern: For which is easier — to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Rise and walk'?

verses.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.modern: But so that You may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins" — He then said to the paralyzed man — "Rise, take up Your mat, and go to Your house."

verses.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.modern: The man rose and went to his house.

verses.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.modern: When the crowds saw it, they were filled with awe and glorified God, Who had given such authority to men.

verses.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.modern: As Jesus passed on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector's booth. He said to Him, "Follow Me." Matthew rose and followed him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.modern: As Jesus reclined at table in the house, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Him and His disciples.

verses.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.modern: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to His disciples, "Why does Your Master eat with tax collectors and sinners?"

verses.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.modern: When Jesus heard this, He said, "Those who are well have no need of a doctor, but those who are sick do.

verses.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.modern: Go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy and not sacrifice.' For I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

verses.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.modern: Then the disciples of John came to him and asked, "Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but Your disciples do not fast?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Can the wedding guests mourn while the bridegroom is with them? The days will come when the bridegroom is taken from them, and then they will fast.

verses.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.modern: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. The patch pulls away from the garment and the tear becomes worse.

verses.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.modern: Nor do people put new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins burst, the wine spills out, and the skins are ruined. They put new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved."

verses.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.modern: While He was saying these things, a ruler came and knelt before Him, saying, "My daughter has just died. But come and lay Your hand on her, and she will live."

verses.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.modern: Jesus rose and followed Him, and so did His disciples.

verses.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.modern: A woman who had suffered from a discharge of blood for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the edge of His garment.

verses.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.modern: She said to herself, "If I only touch His garment, I will be healed."

verses.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.modern: Jesus turned and saw her. He said, "Take courage, daughter. Your faith has made You well." The woman was healed from that moment.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.modern: When Jesus came to the ruler's house and saw the flute players and the noisy crowd,

verses.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.modern: He said, "Go away, for the girl is not dead but sleeping." They laughed at Him.

verses.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.modern: When the crowd had been put outside, He went in and took her by the hand. The girl arose.

verses.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.modern: The report of this spread throughout all that land.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.modern: As Jesus passed on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!"

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.modern: When He entered the house, the blind men came to Him. Jesus said to them, "Do You believe that I am able to do this?" They said to Him, "Yes, Lord."

verses.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.modern: Then He touched their eyes, saying, "Let it be done to You according to Your faith."

verses.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.modern: Their eyes were opened. Jesus sternly warned them, "See that no one knows about this."

verses.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.modern: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout all that region.

verses.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.modern: As they were going out, they brought to Him a mute man who was possessed with a demon.

verses.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.modern: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The crowds were amazed and said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!"

verses.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.modern: But the Pharisees said, "He casts out demons by the ruler of the demons."

verses.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.modern: Jesus went throughout all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

verses.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.modern: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were weary and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

verses.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.modern: He said to His disciples, "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.

verses.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.modern: Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest."

chapters.summary: Jesus heals a paralytic, forgives his sins, and calls Matthew the tax collector to follow Him. He raises a ruler's daughter from the dead, heals a woman with a twelve-year flow of blood, gives sight to two blind men, and casts out a demon from a mute man.

verses.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.modern: Jesus called His twelve disciples to Him and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

verses.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.modern: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

verses.kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.modern: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

verses.kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.modern: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

verses.kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.modern: Jesus sent out these twelve and commanded them, "Do not go in the way of the Gentiles, and do not enter any city of the Samaritans.

verses.kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.modern: Go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

verses.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.modern: As You go, preach, saying, 'The kingdom of heaven is near.'

verses.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.modern: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. Freely You have received — freely give.

verses.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.modern: Take no gold or silver or copper money in Your belts,

verses.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.modern: nor a bag for the journey, nor two tunics, nor sandals, nor a staff. The worker is worthy of His food.

verses.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.modern: Whatever city or town You enter, find out who is worthy in it, and stay there until You leave.

verses.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.modern: When You enter a house, greet it.

verses.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.modern: If the house is worthy, let Your peace come on it. If it is not worthy, let Your peace return to You.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.modern: If anyone will not receive you or listen to your words, when You leave that house or city, shake the dust off Your feet.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that city.

verses.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.modern: I am sending You out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.

verses.kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.modern: Be on guard against men, for they will hand You over to councils and flog You in their synagogues.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.modern: You will be brought before governors and kings for My sake, as a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.modern: When they hand You over, do not worry about how or what You will say. What You are to say will be given to You in that hour.

verses.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.modern: For it is not You who speaks, but the Spirit of Your Father speaking through You.

verses.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.modern: Brother will hand over brother to death, and a father His child. Children will rise up against parents and have them put to death.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.modern: You will be hated by all for My name's sake. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.modern: When they persecute You in one city, flee to the next. Truly I tell You, You will not have gone through all the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

verses.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.modern: A disciple is not above His teacher, nor a servant above His master.

verses.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.modern: It is enough for the disciple to be like his teacher and the servant like his master. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more will they call those of his household!

verses.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.modern: So do not fear them. There is nothing covered that will not be revealed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.

verses.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.modern: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the light. What you hear whispered, proclaim from the housetops.

verses.kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.modern: Do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.modern: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them falls to the ground without your Father's knowledge.

verses.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.modern: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

verses.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.modern: So do not be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
