verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: So everyone who acknowledges Me before men, I will also acknowledge before My Father who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny before My Father who is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.modern: Do not think that I came to bring peace on earth. I did not come to bring peace but a sword.

verses.kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.modern: For I came to set a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

verses.kjv: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.modern: A man's enemies will be those of his own household.

verses.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.modern: Whoever loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me. Whoever loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.

verses.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.modern: Whoever does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.

verses.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.modern: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

verses.kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.modern: Whoever receives you receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives him who sent Me.

verses.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.modern: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. Whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.modern: Whoever gives one of these little ones even a cup of cold water in the name of a disciple — truly I tell you, he will certainly not lose his reward."

chapters.summary: Jesus sends the twelve apostles out with authority to heal the sick, raise the dead, and cast out demons, instructing them to go only to the lost sheep of Israel. He warns them of persecution, teaches them not to fear those who can kill the body, and declares that whoever confesses Him before men, He will confess before the Father.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.modern: When Jesus had finished giving instructions to His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.

verses.kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.modern: When John heard in prison about the works of Christ, He sent word through His disciples

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.modern: and asked Him, "Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for another?"

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Go and tell John what you hear and see:

verses.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.modern: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

verses.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one who does not stumble on account of Me."

verses.kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.modern: As they went away, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

verses.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
verses.modern: What then did You go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Those who wear fine clothes are in kings' houses.

verses.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.modern: What did You go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell You — and more than a prophet.

verses.kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.modern: This is the one of whom it is written: 'I am sending My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way before You.'

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, among those born of women no one has arisen greater than John the Baptist. Yet the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than He.

verses.kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.modern: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been advancing forcefully, and forceful men lay hold of it.

verses.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.modern: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

verses.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.modern: And if You are willing to accept it, He is Elias who was to come.

verses.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.modern: Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.modern: To what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

verses.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.modern: 'We played the flute for You and You did not dance. We sang a lament and You did not mourn.'

verses.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.modern: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, 'He has a demon.'

verses.kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.modern: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, 'Look at this man — a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!' Yet wisdom is proved right by her deeds."

verses.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.modern: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities where most of His mighty works had been done, because they did not repent.

verses.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.modern: "Woe to You, Chorazin! Woe to You, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works done in You had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.modern: But I tell You, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for You.

verses.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.modern: And You, Capernaum — will You be lifted up to heaven? No, You will go down to hell. For if the mighty works done in You had been done in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.modern: But I tell You, it will be more bearable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment than for You."

verses.kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.modern: At that time Jesus said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned and revealed them to little children.

verses.kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.modern: Yes, Father, for this was Your gracious will.

verses.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
verses.modern: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son — and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.

verses.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.modern: Come to Me, all You who are weary and burdened, and I will give You rest.

verses.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.modern: Take My yoke on You and learn from Me, for I am meek and lowly in heart. You will find rest for Your souls.

verses.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.modern: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light."

chapters.summary: John the Baptist, imprisoned, sends messengers to ask Jesus if He is the promised Messiah, and Jesus points to His miracles as evidence. Jesus rebukes the cities of Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum for their unbelief and invites the weary and heavy-laden to come to Him for rest.

verses.kjv: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.modern: At that time Jesus walked through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick heads of grain and eat them.

verses.kjv: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.modern: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to Him, "Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.modern: He said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him —

verses.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.modern: how he entered the house of God and ate the showbread, which was not lawful for Him to eat, nor for those with Him, but only for the priests?

verses.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.modern: Or have you not read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are guiltless?

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.modern: I tell you, something greater than the temple is here.

verses.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.modern: If you had known what this means — 'I desire mercy and not sacrifice' — you would not have condemned the guiltless.

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.modern: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

verses.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.modern: Departing from there, He went into their synagogue.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.modern: A man was there with a withered hand. They asked Jesus, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?" — so they could accuse Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.modern: He said to them, "Which of You, if He has one sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not take hold of it and lift it out?

verses.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.modern: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."

verses.kjv: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.modern: Then He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and it was restored — as whole as the other.

verses.kjv: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.modern: The Pharisees went out and plotted against Him, how they might destroy Him.

verses.kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.modern: Jesus, knowing this, withdrew from there. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all.

verses.kjv: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.modern: He warned them not to make Him known,

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: so that what was spoken by Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled:

verses.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.modern: "My servant whom I have chosen, My beloved in whom My soul delights — I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.modern: He will not quarrel or cry out. No one will hear his voice in the streets.

verses.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.modern: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not snuff out, until He leads justice to victory.

verses.kjv: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.modern: In His name the Gentiles will hope."

verses.kjv: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.modern: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Him. He healed him, so that the mute man both spoke and saw.

verses.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.modern: All the people were amazed and said, "Can this be the Son of David?"

verses.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.modern: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, "This man casts out demons only by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."

verses.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.modern: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to ruin. Every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

verses.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.modern: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

verses.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.modern: If I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your own sons cast them out? They will be your judges.

verses.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.modern: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come to You.

verses.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.modern: How can anyone enter a strong man's house and carry off his possessions unless He first ties up the strong man? Then He can rob His house.

verses.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.modern: Whoever is not with Me is against Me. Whoever does not gather with Me scatters.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.modern: Therefore I tell You, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men. But the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost will not be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.modern: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven. But whoever speaks against the Holy Ghost will not be forgiven — not in this age or in the age to come.

verses.kjv: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.modern: Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree bad and its fruit bad. The tree is known by its fruit.

verses.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.modern: You brood of vipers! How can You speak good things when You are evil? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

verses.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.modern: The good man brings good things out of His good treasure. The evil man brings evil things out of His evil treasure.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.modern: I tell You that on the day of judgment, men will give account for every careless word they speak.

verses.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.modern: By Your words You will be justified, and by Your words You will be condemned."

verses.kjv: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.modern: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, "Master, we want to see a sign from You."

verses.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.modern: He answered them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks for a sign. But no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonas.

verses.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.modern: For just as Jonas was in the belly of the great fish three days and three nights, so the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.

verses.kjv: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.modern: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it. For they repented at the preaching of Jonas, and something greater than Jonas is here.

verses.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.modern: The queen of the south will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it. For she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and something greater than Solomon is here.

verses.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.modern: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and finds none.

verses.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.modern: Then it says, 'I will return to my house from where I came.' When it comes, it finds the house empty, swept, and put in order.

verses.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.modern: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and live there. The final state of that man is worse than the first. So it will be with this evil generation."

verses.kjv: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.modern: While He was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak with Him.

verses.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.modern: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak with You."

verses.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.modern: He replied to the one who told him, "Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?"

verses.kjv: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.modern: Stretching out His hand toward His disciples, He said, "Here are My mother and My brothers.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.modern: Whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother."

chapters.summary: The Pharisees accuse Jesus of breaking the Sabbath when His disciples pluck grain, and Jesus heals a man with a withered hand on the Sabbath. The Pharisees attribute His power to Beelzebub, and Jesus warns that blasphemy against the Holy Ghost will not be forgiven. He declares that His true family are those who do the will of His Father.

verses.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.modern: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.

verses.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.modern: Large crowds gathered around Him, so He got into a boat and sat down. All the crowd stood on the shore.

verses.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.modern: He spoke many things to them in parables, saying: "A sower went out to sow.

verses.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.modern: As He sowed, some seeds fell along the path, and the birds came and ate them up.

verses.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.modern: Other seeds fell on rocky ground, where they did not have much soil. They sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

verses.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.modern: When the sun rose, they were scorched. Since they had no root, they withered away.

verses.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.modern: Other seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.

verses.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.modern: Still other seeds fell on good soil and produced a crop — a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.

verses.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.modern: Whoever has ears, let him hear."

verses.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.modern: The disciples came and asked Him, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"

verses.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.modern: He answered, "It has been given to You to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been given.

verses.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.modern: Whoever has, more will be given to him, and he will have great abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from Him.

verses.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.modern: This is why I speak to them in parables — because seeing, they do not see; and hearing, they do not hear or understand.

verses.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.modern: In them the prophecy of Esaias is fulfilled: 'You will keep on hearing but never understand, and You will keep on seeing but never perceive.

verses.kjv: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.modern: For this people's heart has grown dull. Their ears are hard of hearing, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes and hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn — and I would heal them.'

verses.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.modern: But blessed are Your eyes, because they see, and Your ears, because they hear.

verses.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what You see but did not see it, and to hear what You hear but did not hear it.

verses.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.modern: Hear then the parable of the sower.

verses.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.modern: When anyone hears the word of the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in His heart. This is what was sown along the path.

verses.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.modern: As for what was sown on rocky ground, this is the one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy.

verses.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.modern: But He has no root in Himself. He lasts only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, He quickly falls away.

verses.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.modern: As for what was sown among thorns, this is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this world and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

verses.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.modern: As for what was sown on good ground, this is the one who hears the word and understands it. He produces fruit — some a hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty."

verses.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.modern: He put another parable before them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

verses.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.modern: While men were sleeping, His enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, then went away.

verses.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.modern: When the grain sprouted and formed heads, the weeds also appeared.

verses.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.modern: The servants of the master came and said to Him, 'Sir, did You not sow good seed in Your field? Where then did the weeds come from?'

verses.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.modern: He said to them, 'An enemy did this.' The servants asked Him, 'Do You want us to go and pull them up?'

verses.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.modern: He said, 'No, lest when You gather the weeds You root up the wheat with them.

verses.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.modern: Let both grow together until the harvest. At harvest time I will tell the reapers: Gather the weeds first and bind them in bundles to be burned, but gather the wheat into my barn.'"

verses.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.modern: He put another parable before them, saying, "The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed that a man took and sowed in his field.

verses.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.modern: It is the smallest of all seeds, but when it grows, it becomes the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches."

verses.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.modern: He spoke another parable to them: "The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened."

verses.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.modern: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not say anything to them without using a parable.

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.modern: This was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet: "I will open My mouth in parables. I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.modern: Then Jesus sent the crowds away and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field."

verses.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.modern: He answered, "The one who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.modern: The field is the world. The good seed are the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one.

verses.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.modern: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the world. The reapers are the angels.

verses.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.modern: As the weeds are gathered and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of this world.

verses.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.modern: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom everything that causes sin and all who practice iniquity.

verses.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: They will throw them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.modern: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let him hear.

verses.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.modern: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again. Then in his joy he went and sold everything He had and bought that field.

verses.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.modern: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking fine pearls.

verses.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.modern: When He found one pearl of great value, He went and sold everything He had and bought it.

verses.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.modern: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was thrown into the sea and gathered fish of every kind.

verses.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.modern: When it was full, men drew it to shore. They sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw out the bad ones.

verses.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.modern: So it will be at the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous

verses.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: and throw them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Have You understood all these things?" They said to Him, "Yes, Lord."

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Therefore every scribe trained for the kingdom of heaven is like a master of a house who brings out of His treasure things new and old."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.modern: When Jesus had finished these parables, He departed from there.

verses.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.modern: Coming to His hometown, He taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished. They said, "Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

verses.kjv: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.modern: Is not this the carpenter's son? Is not His mother called Mary? Are not his brothers James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

verses.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.modern: Are not all His sisters here with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"

verses.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.modern: They were offended by Him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in His own hometown and in His own house."

verses.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.modern: He did not do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches the crowds in parables, including the sower, the wheat and tares, the mustard seed, the leaven, the hidden treasure, the pearl of great price, and the dragnet. His own people in Nazareth reject Him, and He marvels at their unbelief.

verses.kjv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
verses.modern: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus.

verses.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.modern: He said to His servants, "This is John the Baptist. He has risen from the dead, and that is why these miraculous powers are at work in Him."

verses.kjv: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
verses.modern: For Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison, for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

verses.kjv: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.modern: For John had told him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."

verses.kjv: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.modern: Herod wanted to put John to death, but he feared the people because they regarded John as a prophet.

verses.kjv: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.modern: When Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced before the guests and pleased Herod.

verses.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.modern: He therefore promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

verses.kjv: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
verses.modern: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me here the head of John the Baptist on a platter."

verses.kjv: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
verses.modern: The king was grieved, but because of his oath and his guests, he commanded it to be given.

verses.kjv: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.modern: He sent and had John beheaded in the prison.

verses.kjv: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.modern: His head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.

verses.kjv: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.modern: John's disciples came and took the body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.modern: When Jesus heard this, He withdrew from there by boat to a remote place by Himself. But when the crowds heard it, they followed Him on foot from the cities.

verses.kjv: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.modern: When Jesus came ashore, He saw a large crowd. He was moved with compassion for them and healed their sick.

verses.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.modern: When evening came, His disciples came to Him and said, "This is a remote place and the hour is already late. Send the crowds away so they can go into the villages and buy themselves food."

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat."

verses.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.modern: They said to Him, "We have only five loaves here and two fish."

verses.kjv: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.modern: He said, "Bring them here to Me."

verses.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.modern: He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and two fish, He looked up to heaven and gave thanks. He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.

verses.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.modern: They all ate and were satisfied. They picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.modern: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.kjv: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.modern: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go ahead of Him to the other side, while He sent the crowds away.

verses.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.modern: After He had sent the crowds away, He went up on a mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone.

verses.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.modern: The boat was already far from shore, being tossed by the waves, for the wind was against them.

verses.kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.modern: In the fourth watch of the night — between three and six in the morning — Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

verses.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.modern: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. "It is a ghost!" they said, and they cried out in fear.

verses.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.modern: But Jesus immediately spoke to them: "Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid."

verses.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.modern: Peter answered him, "Lord, if it is you, command me to come to You on the water."

verses.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.modern: He said, "Come." Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus.

verses.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.modern: But when He noticed the strong wind, He was afraid. Beginning to sink, He cried out, "Lord, save me!"

verses.kjv: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.modern: Immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and caught Him. He said, "O You of little faith, why did You doubt?"

verses.kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.modern: When they got into the boat, the wind died down.

verses.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.modern: Those in the boat worshiped Him, saying, "Truly You are the Son of God."

verses.kjv: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.modern: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret.

verses.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.modern: The men of that place recognized Him and sent word throughout all the surrounding region. They brought to Him all who were sick.

verses.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.modern: They begged Him to let them touch even the edge of His garment. All who touched it were completely healed.

chapters.summary: Herod beheads John the Baptist in prison after being manipulated by Herodias and her daughter. Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves and two fish, then walks on the water to His disciples' boat, and Peter briefly walks on the water before sinking in fear.

verses.kjv: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.modern: Then some scribes and Pharisees came from Jerusalem to Jesus and said,

verses.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.modern: "Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They don't wash their hands before they eat."

verses.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
verses.modern: He answered, "Why do You also break the commandment of God for the sake of Your tradition?

verses.kjv: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.modern: God commanded, 'Honor Your father and Your mother,' and 'Whoever curses his father or mother must be put to death.'

verses.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
verses.modern: But You say that if anyone tells his father or mother, 'Whatever help you might have received from me is a gift devoted to God,'

verses.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
verses.modern: he need not honor His father or mother. You have nullified the word of God for the sake of Your tradition.

verses.kjv: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.modern: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied well about you when he said,

verses.kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.modern: 'This people honors Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me.

verses.kjv: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.modern: Their worship of Me is empty, for they teach human rules as though they were God's commands.'"

verses.kjv: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.modern: He called the crowd to Him and said, "Listen and understand.

verses.kjv: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
verses.modern: It is not what goes into the mouth that makes a person unclean. It is what comes out of the mouth that makes a person unclean."

verses.kjv: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.modern: Then His disciples came and said to Him, "Do You know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?"

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.modern: He answered, "Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.

verses.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.modern: Leave them alone. They are blind guides leading the blind. If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit."

verses.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.modern: Peter said to him, "Explain this parable to us."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Are You still so slow to understand?

verses.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.modern: Don't You see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?

verses.kjv: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.modern: But what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and those things make a person unclean.

verses.kjv: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.modern: From the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.

verses.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
verses.modern: These are what make a person unclean. But eating with unwashed hands does not make a person unclean."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.modern: Jesus left from there and went to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.kjv: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.modern: A Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is badly tormented by a demon."

verses.kjv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.modern: He did not answer her a word. His disciples came and urged Him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.modern: He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

verses.kjv: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.modern: But she came and knelt before Him, saying, "Lord, help me!"

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
verses.modern: He replied, "It is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."

verses.kjv: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
verses.modern: She said, "Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.modern: Then Jesus answered her, "Woman, Your faith is great! Let it be done for You as You wish." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

verses.kjv: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.modern: Jesus left that place and went along the Sea of Galilee. He went up on a hillside and sat down.

verses.kjv: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
verses.modern: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the mute, the crippled, and many others, and laid them at His feet. He healed them.

verses.kjv: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.modern: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. They praised the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.modern: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, "I feel compassion for this crowd. They have been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way."

verses.kjv: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.modern: His disciples said to Him, "Where would we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a large crowd?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.modern: Jesus asked them, "How many loaves do You have?" They said, "Seven, and a few small fish."

verses.kjv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.modern: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.

verses.kjv: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.modern: Then He took the seven loaves and the fish, gave thanks, broke them, and gave them to the disciples. The disciples gave them to the crowd.

verses.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
verses.modern: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.modern: The number of those who ate was four thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.modern: After sending the crowd away, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magdala.

chapters.summary: Jesus rebukes the Pharisees for placing their traditions above the commandments of God and teaches that what defiles a man comes from the heart, not from unwashed hands. He heals the daughter of a Canaanite woman and feeds four thousand men with seven loaves and a few fish.

verses.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.modern: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested Him by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.

verses.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.modern: He replied, "When evening comes, You say, 'It will be good weather, for the sky is red.'

verses.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
verses.modern: And in the morning You say, 'It will be stormy today, for the sky is red and threatening.' You know how to read the sky, but You cannot read the signs of the times.

verses.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.modern: A wicked and unfaithful generation asks for a sign. No sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah." He left them and went away.

verses.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.modern: When the disciples crossed to the other side of the lake, they had forgotten to bring bread.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Watch out — be on guard against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

verses.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
verses.modern: They discussed this among themselves, saying, "He said this because we didn't bring bread."

verses.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
verses.modern: Knowing their discussion, Jesus said, "You of little faith, why are You talking among yourselves about having no bread?

verses.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.modern: Don't You remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets You gathered?

verses.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.modern: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets You gathered?

verses.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.modern: How do You not understand that I was not talking about bread? Guard yourselves against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

verses.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.modern: Then they understood that He was not telling them to guard against the leaven in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

verses.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
verses.modern: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He asked His disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"

verses.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.modern: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others say Jeremiah or one of the prophets."

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
verses.modern: "But who do you say I am?" He asked.

verses.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.modern: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Blessed are You, Simon son of Jonah! Flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.modern: And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church. The gates of hell will not overcome it.

verses.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.modern: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."

verses.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.modern: Then He instructed the disciples to tell no one that he was the Christ.

verses.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.modern: From that time on, Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem. He would suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes. He would be killed, and on the third day be raised to life.

verses.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
verses.modern: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This will never happen to You!"

verses.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
verses.modern: Jesus turned and said to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. You are not setting your mind on the things of God, but the things of men."

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.modern: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "If anyone wants to follow Me, he must deny himself, take up His cross, and follow Me.

verses.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.modern: Whoever wants to save his life will lose it. But whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

verses.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.modern: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world yet lose his own soul? What can a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.modern: The Son of Man will come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and then He will reward each person according to what He has done.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom."

chapters.summary: The Pharisees and Sadducees demand a sign, and Jesus warns His disciples of their leaven. Peter confesses that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God, and Jesus reveals that He must go to Jerusalem, suffer, be killed, and rise again on the third day.

verses.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.modern: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John his brother and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

verses.kjv: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.modern: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.modern: Moses and Elijah appeared and were talking with him.

verses.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.modern: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will make three shelters — one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

verses.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.modern: While He was still speaking, a bright cloud came over them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!"

verses.kjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.modern: When the disciples heard this, they fell face down and were terrified.

verses.kjv: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.modern: Jesus came and touched them. "Get up," He said. "Do not be afraid."

verses.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.modern: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

verses.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.modern: As they came down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, "Tell no one what you have seen until the Son of Man is raised from the dead."

verses.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.modern: His disciples asked Him, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Elijah does come first, and will restore all things.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.modern: But I tell You, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize Him but did to Him whatever they pleased. So also the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."

verses.kjv: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.modern: Then the disciples understood that He was talking to them about John the Baptist.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.modern: When they came to the crowd, a man came to Jesus, knelt before Him, and said,

verses.kjv: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.modern: "Lord, have mercy on my son. He has seizures and suffers greatly. He often falls into the fire and often into the water.

verses.kjv: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.modern: I brought Him to Your disciples, but they could not heal Him."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "You faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with You? How long shall I put up with You? Bring Him here to Me."

verses.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.modern: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of Him. The boy was healed from that very hour.

verses.kjv: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.modern: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Because of Your unbelief. Truly I tell You, if You have faith as small as a mustard seed, You can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for You."

verses.kjv: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
verses.modern: But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.

verses.kjv: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.modern: While they were gathered in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men.

verses.kjv: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.modern: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life." The disciples were deeply grieved.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
verses.modern: When they arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the temple tax came to Peter and asked, "Doesn't your teacher pay the temple tax?"

verses.kjv: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.modern: "Yes, He does," Peter replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus spoke to Him first: "What do You think, Simon? From whom do earthly kings collect taxes — from their own sons or from others?"

verses.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.modern: "From others," Peter answered. "Then the sons are exempt," Jesus said to Him.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
verses.modern: But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea and cast a hook. Take the first fish that comes up, and when You open its mouth, You will find a coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and Yours."

chapters.summary: Jesus is transfigured on a high mountain before Peter, James, and John, and His face shines like the sun as Moses and Elijah appear with Him. He heals a demon-possessed boy the disciples could not cure and tells Peter to pay the temple tax with a coin found in a fish's mouth.

verses.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
verses.modern: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
verses.modern: He called a little child over and set Him in the middle of them.

verses.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: He said, "Truly I tell You, unless You change and become like little children, You will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: Whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
verses.modern: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.

verses.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.modern: But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble — it would be better for Him to have a large millstone hung around His neck and be drowned in the depths of the sea.

verses.kjv: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
verses.modern: Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to stumble! Such things must come, but woe to the person through whom they come!

verses.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
verses.modern: If Your hand or Your foot causes You to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better to enter life lame or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into everlasting fire.

verses.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
verses.modern: If Your eye causes You to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away. It is better to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell fire.

verses.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: See that You do not look down on one of these little ones. I tell You that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
verses.modern: The Son of Man came to save what was lost.

verses.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
verses.modern: What do You think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one wanders away, will He not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?

verses.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
verses.modern: If He finds it, truly I tell You, He is happier over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not wander off.

verses.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.modern: In the same way, it is not the will of Your Father in heaven that any of these little ones should perish.

verses.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
verses.modern: If Your brother sins against You, go and show Him His fault — just between the two of You. If He listens to You, You have won Your brother back.

verses.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.modern: But if He will not listen, take one or two others along, so that every matter may be confirmed by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
verses.modern: If He refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. If He refuses to listen even to the church, treat Him as You would a pagan or a tax collector.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, whatever You bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever You loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

verses.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.modern: Again, truly I tell You, if two of You on earth agree about anything You ask for, it will be done for You by My Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.modern: For where two or three gather in My name, I am there with them."

verses.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
verses.modern: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when He sins against me? Up to seven times?"

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "I tell You, not seven times, but seventy times seven.

verses.kjv: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
verses.modern: The kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with His servants.

verses.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
verses.modern: As He began the accounting, a man who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to Him.
