verses.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.modern: Since He could not pay, the master ordered that He, his wife, His children, and all that He had be sold to repay the debt.

verses.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.modern: The servant fell on his knees before him. "Be patient with me," he begged, "and I will pay back everything."

verses.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.modern: The servant's master felt compassion for him, released Him, and forgave the debt.

verses.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
verses.modern: But when that same servant went out, He found one of His fellow servants who owed Him a hundred denarii. He grabbed Him and choked Him. "Pay back what You owe me!" he demanded.

verses.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.modern: His fellow servant fell on His knees and begged Him, "Be patient with me, and I will pay You back."

verses.kjv: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.modern: But he refused. He went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.

verses.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.modern: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were deeply distressed and told their master everything.

verses.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
verses.modern: Then the master called the servant in. "You wicked servant," he said, "I forgave all that debt of yours because you begged me.

verses.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
verses.modern: Should you not also have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?"

verses.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.modern: In his anger, the master handed him over to the jailers to be tortured until he paid back all he owed.

verses.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.modern: This is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart."

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches about humility, warning His disciples that they must become like little children to enter the kingdom of heaven. He tells the parable of the lost sheep and the parable of the unforgiving servant, and instructs on how to handle sin within the church.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.modern: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went to the region of Judea on the other side of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.modern: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.

verses.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.modern: Some Pharisees came to test Him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?"

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.modern: He answered, "Have You not read that He who created them from the beginning made them male and female,

verses.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.modern: and said, 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh'?

verses.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.modern: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no man separate."

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.modern: "Why then," they asked, "did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?"

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of Your hard hearts. But it was not this way from the beginning.

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.modern: I tell You that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another commits adultery."

verses.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.modern: The disciples said to Him, "If that is how it is between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."

verses.kjv: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this teaching — only those to whom it has been given.

verses.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.modern: Some are born without the ability to marry. Some are made that way by others. And some choose to live that way for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Let the one who can accept this accept it."

verses.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.modern: Then little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray. But the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

verses.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Let the little children come to Me and do not stop them. The kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."

verses.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.modern: He placed His hands on them and then left from there.

verses.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.modern: A man came to Jesus and asked, "Master, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Why do You ask Me about what is good? There is only One who is good. If You want to enter life, keep the commandments."

verses.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.modern: "Which ones?" he asked. Jesus replied, "Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony,

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.modern: honor Your father and mother, and love Your neighbor as Yourself."

verses.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.modern: The young man said, "I have kept all these. What do I still lack?"

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "If You want to be perfect, go and sell what You own and give the money to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Then come and follow Me."

verses.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.modern: When the young man heard this, He went away sad, because He had great wealth.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.modern: Then Jesus said to His disciples, "Truly I tell You, it is hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: Again I tell You, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceeding amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.modern: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?"

verses.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.modern: Jesus looked at them and said, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

verses.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.modern: Peter answered him, "We have left everything to follow You! What then will there be for us?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell You, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, You who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.modern: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for My sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

verses.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
verses.modern: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches on marriage and divorce, blesses little children, and tells a rich young man to sell all he has and follow Him. The young man goes away sorrowful, and Jesus tells His disciples it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.modern: The kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

verses.kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.modern: He agreed to pay the workers a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

verses.kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.modern: About nine in the morning He went out and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

verses.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.modern: He told them, "You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay You what is right." So they went.

verses.kjv: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.modern: He went out again about noon and at three in the afternoon and did the same.

verses.kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.modern: About five in the afternoon He went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, "Why have You been standing here all day doing nothing?"

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
verses.modern: "Because no one has hired us," they answered. He said to them, "You also go and work in my vineyard."

verses.kjv: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.modern: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to His foreman, "Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first."

verses.kjv: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.modern: The workers hired about five in the afternoon came, and each received a denarius.

verses.kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.modern: When the workers hired first came, they expected to receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.

verses.kjv: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.modern: When they received it, they grumbled against the landowner.

verses.kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.modern: "These workers hired last worked only one hour," they said, "and You have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and heat of the day."

verses.kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.modern: He answered one of them, "Friend, I am not treating You unfairly. Didn't You agree to work for a denarius?

verses.kjv: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.modern: Take Your pay and go. I want to give the last worker hired the same as I gave You.

verses.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.modern: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are You envious because I am generous?"

verses.kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.modern: So the last will be first, and the first will be last. For many are called, but few are chosen."

verses.kjv: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.modern: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said to them,

verses.kjv: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.modern: "We are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn Him to death

verses.kjv: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.modern: and hand Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked, flogged, and crucified. On the third day He will be raised to life."

verses.kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.modern: Then the mother of Zebedee's sons came to Jesus with her sons. She knelt down and asked something of Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.modern: "What do You want?" He asked. She said, "Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your kingdom."

verses.kjv: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "You don't know what You are asking. Can You drink the cup I am going to drink?" "We can," they answered.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink from My cup. But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant — it belongs to those for whom it has been prepared by My Father."

verses.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.modern: When the other ten disciples heard about this, they were indignant at the two brothers.

verses.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.modern: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

verses.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.modern: It is not to be that way with You. Whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant,

verses.kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.modern: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave —

verses.kjv: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.modern: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many."

verses.kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.modern: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
verses.modern: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
verses.modern: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they cried out all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.modern: Jesus stopped and called them. "What do You want Me to do for You?" He asked.

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.modern: "Lord," they answered, "we want our eyes to be opened."

verses.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.modern: Jesus felt compassion for them and touched their eyes. Immediately they could see, and they followed Him.

chapters.summary: Jesus tells the parable of the laborers in the vineyard, where those hired last receive the same wage as those hired first. He foretells His crucifixion and resurrection a third time, rebukes the ambition of James and John's mother, and heals two blind men near Jericho.

verses.kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.modern: When they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples ahead.

verses.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Go into the village ahead of You, and at once You will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.

verses.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.modern: If anyone says anything to you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and He will send them right away."

verses.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.modern: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

verses.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.modern: "Tell the daughter of Zion, 'See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.'"

verses.kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.modern: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.

verses.kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
verses.modern: They brought the donkey and the colt, placed their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.

verses.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.modern: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

verses.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.modern: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

verses.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.modern: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"

verses.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.modern: The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."

verses.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.modern: Jesus entered the temple of God and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.modern: He said to them, "It is written, 'My house will be called a house of prayer,' but You have made it a den of thieves."

verses.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.modern: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.

verses.kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.modern: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things He did, and the children crying out in the temple, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.modern: "Do You hear what these children are saying?" they asked Him. "Yes," Jesus replied. "Have You never read, 'From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise'?"

verses.kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.modern: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He stayed that night.

verses.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.modern: Early in the morning, as He was returning to the city, He was hungry.

verses.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.modern: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. He said to it, "May You never bear fruit again!" At once the fig tree withered.

verses.kjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.modern: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Truly I tell You, if You have faith and do not doubt, You can do not only what was done to the fig tree, but also say to this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and it will be done.

verses.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.modern: Whatever You ask for in prayer, if You believe, You will receive."

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.modern: Jesus entered the temple, and while He was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave You this authority?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "I will also ask You one question. If You answer Me, I will tell You by what authority I do these things.

verses.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.modern: John's baptism — where did it come from? From heaven, or from men?" They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will ask, 'Then why didn't You believe Him?'

verses.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.modern: But if we say, 'From men,' we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet."

verses.kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.modern: So they answered Jesus, "We don't know." He said to them, "Neither will I tell You by what authority I am doing these things.

verses.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.modern: What do You think? A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, 'Son, go and work in the vineyard today.'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.modern: 'I will not,' he answered, but later He changed His mind and went.

verses.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
verses.modern: The father went to the second son and said the same. He answered, 'I will, sir,' but He did not go.

verses.kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.modern: Which of the two did the will of His father?" "The first," they answered. Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell You, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of You.

verses.kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.modern: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe Him. But the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed Him. And even after You saw this, You did not repent and believe Him.

verses.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.modern: Listen to another parable. There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress, and built a watchtower. Then He rented the vineyard to some farmers and went away on a journey.

verses.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.modern: When harvest time approached, He sent His servants to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit.

verses.kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.modern: But the farmers seized His servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

verses.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.modern: Then He sent more servants than the first group, and they treated them the same way.

verses.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.modern: Last of all, He sent His son to them. "They will respect my son," he said.

verses.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.modern: But when the farmers saw the son, they said to each other, "This is the heir. Come, let us kill Him and take His inheritance."

verses.kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
verses.modern: So they seized Him, threw Him out of the vineyard, and killed Him.

verses.kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.modern: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will He do to those farmers?"

verses.kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.modern: "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and He will rent the vineyard to other farmers who will give Him His share at harvest time."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "Have You never read in the Scriptures: 'The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. The Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?

verses.kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.modern: Therefore I tell You that the kingdom of God will be taken from You and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.modern: Whoever falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and it will crush anyone it falls on."

verses.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.modern: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard His parables, they knew He was speaking about them.

verses.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.modern: They looked for a way to arrest Him, but they were afraid of the crowd, because the people regarded him as a prophet.

chapters.summary: Jesus enters Jerusalem riding on a donkey as crowds cry 'Hosanna to the Son of David.' He drives out the money changers from the temple, curses a fig tree that withers, and challenges the chief priests and elders with the parables of the two sons and the wicked husbandmen.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
verses.modern: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying,

verses.kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.modern: "The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for His son.

verses.kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.modern: He sent His servants to call those who had been invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.

verses.kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.modern: Then He sent more servants and said, 'Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been slaughtered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.'

verses.kjv: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.modern: But they paid no attention and went away — one to His field, another to His business.

verses.kjv: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
verses.modern: The rest seized His servants, mistreated them, and killed them.

verses.kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.modern: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

verses.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.modern: Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.

verses.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.modern: Go to the street corners and invite anyone you find to the banquet.'

verses.kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.modern: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, both bad and good. The wedding hall was filled with guests.

verses.kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.modern: But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.modern: "Friend," he asked, "how did you get in here without wedding clothes?" The man had no answer.

verses.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: Then the king told the servants, "Tie him hand and foot and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

verses.kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.modern: For many are called, but few are chosen."

verses.kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
verses.modern: Then the Pharisees went out and made plans to trap Jesus in His words.

verses.kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.modern: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. "Master," they said, "we know You are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God truthfully. You are not influenced by others, because You pay no attention to who they are.

verses.kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.modern: Tell us then, what is Your opinion? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

verses.kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
verses.modern: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, "You hypocrites, why are You trying to trap Me?

verses.kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.modern: Show Me the coin used for paying the tax." They brought Him a denarius.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.modern: He asked them, "Whose image is this, and whose inscription?"

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
verses.modern: "Caesar's," they replied. He said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and give to God what is God's."

verses.kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.modern: When they heard this, they were amazed. They left Him and went away.

verses.kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.modern: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him with a question.

verses.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.modern: "Master," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him.

verses.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.modern: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

verses.kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.modern: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

verses.kjv: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.modern: Last of all, the woman died.

verses.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.modern: So then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven? They all had her."

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "You are wrong because You know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God.

verses.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.modern: At the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. They will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.modern: But about the resurrection of the dead — have You not read what God said to You:

verses.kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.modern: 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? He is not the God of the dead but of the living."

verses.kjv: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.modern: When the crowd heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.

verses.kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.modern: When the Pharisees heard that He had silenced the Sadducees, they came together.

verses.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.modern: One of them, a lawyer, tested Him with this question:

verses.kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.modern: "Master, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Love the Lord Your God with all Your heart and with all Your soul and with all Your mind.

verses.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.modern: This is the first and greatest commandment.

verses.kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.modern: And the second is like it: Love Your neighbor as Yourself.

verses.kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.modern: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments."

verses.kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
verses.modern: While the Pharisees were gathered, Jesus asked them,

verses.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
verses.modern: "What do You think about the Christ? Whose son is He?" "The son of David," they replied.

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.modern: He said to them, "How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls Him 'Lord'? For He says,

verses.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.modern: 'The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet."'

verses.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.modern: If then David calls him 'Lord,' how can he be his son?"

verses.kjv: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.modern: No one could answer him a word, and from that day on no one dared to question him any further.

chapters.summary: Jesus tells the parable of the marriage feast, where those first invited refuse to come and the king sends his servants into the highways. The Pharisees, Sadducees, and Herodians test Him with questions about paying tribute to Caesar, the resurrection, and the greatest commandment.

verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.modern: Then Jesus spoke to the crowd and to His disciples.

verses.kjv: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.modern: He said, "The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat.

verses.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.modern: So practice and obey everything they tell you. But do not follow their example, because they do not practice what they teach.

verses.kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.modern: They tie up heavy loads and put them on other people's shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

verses.kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.modern: Everything they do is done for people to see. They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long.

verses.kjv: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.modern: They love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues.

verses.kjv: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.modern: They love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called 'Rabbi' by others.

verses.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.modern: But you are not to be called 'Rabbi,' for you have one Master, and you are all brothers.

verses.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.modern: And do not call anyone on earth 'father,' for you have one Father, and He is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.modern: Nor are You to be called 'Master,' for You have one Master — the Christ.

verses.kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.modern: The greatest among You will be Your servant.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.modern: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

verses.kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in people's faces. You yourselves do not enter, and You block those who are trying to enter.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You devour widows' houses and for appearance make long prayers. Therefore You will receive the greater damnation.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when You have won Him, You make Him twice as much a child of hell as You are.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.modern: Woe to You, blind guides! You say, "If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing. But if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by His oath."

verses.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.modern: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

verses.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.modern: You also say, "If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing. But if anyone swears by the gift on the altar, he is bound by His oath."

verses.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.modern: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

verses.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.modern: Therefore, whoever swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

verses.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.modern: Whoever swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who lives in it.

verses.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.modern: And whoever swears by heaven swears by the throne of God and by the One who sits on it.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You give a tenth of Your spices — mint, anise, and cumin. But You have neglected the more important matters of the law: judgment, mercy, and faith. You should have practiced these without neglecting the others.

verses.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.modern: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

verses.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.modern: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside will also be clean.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men's bones and everything unclean.

verses.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.modern: In the same way, on the outside You appear righteous to others, but on the inside You are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.modern: Woe to You, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

verses.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.modern: You say, "If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part in shedding the blood of the prophets."

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.modern: By saying this, You testify against yourselves that You are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

verses.kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.modern: Go ahead, then, and complete what Your ancestors started!

verses.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.modern: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will You escape the damnation of hell?

verses.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.modern: Therefore I am sending You prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them You will kill and crucify. Others You will flog in Your synagogues and pursue from town to town.

verses.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.modern: So on you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.modern: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.

verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.modern: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you! How often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing!

verses.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.modern: Your house is left to you desolate.

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.modern: For I tell you, you will not see Me again until you say, "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord."

chapters.summary: Jesus pronounces seven woes on the scribes and Pharisees, calling them hypocrites, blind guides, and whitewashed tombs. He laments over Jerusalem, declaring that her house is left desolate and that she will not see Him again until she says, 'Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.modern: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when His disciples came up to point out the temple buildings to Him.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Do You see all these things? Truly I tell You, not one stone here will be left on another — every one will be thrown down."

verses.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.modern: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. "Tell us," they said, "when will this happen? And what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the world?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Watch out that no one deceives you.

verses.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.modern: Many will come in My name, claiming, 'I am the Christ,' and will deceive many.

verses.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.modern: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that You are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

verses.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.modern: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

verses.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.modern: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

verses.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
verses.modern: Then You will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death. You will be hated by all nations because of Me.

verses.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.modern: At that time many will fall away. They will betray one another and hate one another.

verses.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.modern: Many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

verses.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.modern: Because iniquity will increase, the love of most will grow cold.

verses.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.modern: But the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

verses.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.modern: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

verses.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.modern: So when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of through the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place — let the reader understand —

verses.kjv: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.modern: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

verses.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.modern: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.

verses.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.modern: Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak.

verses.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.modern: Woe to pregnant women and nursing mothers in those days!

verses.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.modern: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.modern: For then there will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now — and never will be again.

verses.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.modern: If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be shortened.

verses.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
verses.modern: At that time if anyone says to you, 'Here is the Christ!' or 'There He is!' do not believe it.

verses.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.modern: False christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders — so great as to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.modern: I have told You this ahead of time.

verses.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
verses.modern: So if anyone tells you, 'He is out in the desert,' do not go out. Or, 'He is in the inner rooms,' do not believe it.

verses.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.modern: For as the lightning comes from the east and flashes to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.modern: Wherever the carcass is, there the vultures will gather.

verses.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.modern: Immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light. The stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

verses.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.modern: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven. All the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.modern: He will send His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

verses.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
verses.modern: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and put out leaves, You know that summer is near.

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
verses.modern: In the same way, when You see all these things, You know that it is near, right at the door.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.modern: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

verses.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.modern: But about that day or hour no one knows — not even the angels in heaven — but My Father only.

verses.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.modern: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.modern: In the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, right up to the day Noah entered the ark.

verses.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.modern: They knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and swept them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.modern: Two men will be in the field — one will be taken and the other left.

verses.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.modern: Two women will be grinding at the mill — one will be taken and the other left.

verses.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.modern: Therefore keep watch, because You do not know on what day Your Lord will come.

verses.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.modern: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, He would have stayed awake and not let His house be broken into.

verses.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.modern: So You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when You do not expect Him.

verses.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.modern: Who then is the faithful and wise servant whom the master has put in charge of his household to give them their food at the proper time?

verses.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.modern: It will go well for that servant whose master finds Him doing this when He returns.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, He will put Him in charge of all His possessions.

verses.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.modern: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to Himself, "My master is delayed,"

verses.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.modern: and He begins to strike His fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

verses.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.modern: The master of that servant will come on a day He does not expect and at an hour He is not aware of.

verses.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: He will cut Him to pieces and assign Him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

chapters.summary: Jesus foretells the destruction of the temple and the signs of His second coming, including wars, famines, false prophets, and the abomination of desolation. He warns His disciples to watch and be ready, for the Son of man will come at an hour they do not expect.

verses.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.modern: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

verses.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.modern: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

verses.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.modern: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

verses.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.modern: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.

verses.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.modern: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all grew drowsy and fell asleep.

verses.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.modern: At midnight the cry rang out: "Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet Him!"

verses.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.modern: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.

verses.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.modern: The foolish ones said to the wise, "Give us some of Your oil — our lamps are going out."

verses.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.modern: "No," they replied, "there may not be enough for both us and You. Go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves."

verses.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.modern: But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The ones who were ready went in with Him to the wedding banquet. The door was shut.

verses.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.modern: Later the others also came. "Lord! Lord!" they said. "Open the door for us!"

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.modern: But He replied, "Truly I tell You, I do not know You."

verses.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.modern: Therefore keep watch, because You do not know the day or the hour.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.modern: It is like a man going on a journey who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.

verses.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.modern: To one He gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent — each according to His ability. Then He went on His journey.

verses.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.modern: The man who had received five talents went at once and put his money to work and gained five more.

verses.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.modern: In the same way, the one with two talents gained two more.

verses.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
verses.modern: But the man who had received one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master's money.

verses.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.modern: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

verses.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.modern: The man who had received five talents came and brought the other five. "Master," he said, "you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more."

verses.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.modern: His master replied, "Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!"

verses.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.modern: The man with two talents also came. "Master," he said, "you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more."

verses.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.modern: His master replied, "Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!"

verses.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.modern: Then the man who had received one talent came. "Master," he said, "I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

verses.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
verses.modern: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. Here is what belongs to you."

verses.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.modern: His master replied, "You wicked and lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

verses.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.modern: Then you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.

verses.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.modern: Take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.

verses.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.modern: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But from the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away.

verses.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.modern: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

verses.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.modern: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the holy angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.

verses.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
verses.modern: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people from one another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

verses.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.modern: He will put the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.

verses.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.modern: Then the King will say to those on his right, "Come, you who are blessed by My Father. Inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

verses.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.modern: For I was hungry and you gave Me food. I was thirsty and you gave Me drink. I was a stranger and you took Me in.

verses.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.modern: I was naked and you clothed Me. I was sick and you looked after Me. I was in prison and you came to visit Me."

verses.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
verses.modern: Then the righteous will answer him, "Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?

verses.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
verses.modern: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?

verses.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.modern: When did we see You sick or in prison and go to visit You?"

verses.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verses.modern: The King will reply, "Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me."

verses.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.modern: Then He will say to those on His left, "Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

verses.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.modern: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat. I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink.

verses.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.modern: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in. I was naked and you did not clothe Me. I was sick and in prison and you did not visit Me."

verses.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.modern: They also will answer, "Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not help You?"

verses.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
verses.modern: He will reply, "Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me."

verses.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.modern: Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."

chapters.summary: Jesus tells the parable of the ten virgins, the parable of the talents, and describes the final judgment when the Son of man separates the nations as a shepherd separates sheep from goats. Those who served the least of His brethren enter eternal life, and those who did not are cast into everlasting punishment.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.modern: When Jesus had finished all these teachings, He said to His disciples,

verses.kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.modern: "As You know, the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."

verses.kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.modern: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people gathered at the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

verses.kjv: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.modern: They made plans to arrest Jesus secretly and kill Him.

verses.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.modern: "But not during the feast," they said, "or there may be a riot among the people."

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.modern: While Jesus was in Bethany at the house of Simon the leper,

verses.kjv: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.modern: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume and poured it on His head as He was reclining at the table.

verses.kjv: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.modern: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. "Why this waste?" they asked.

verses.kjv: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.modern: "This could have been sold for a great deal of money and given to the poor."
