verses.kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.modern: Aware of their reaction, Jesus said to them, "Why are You bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing for Me.

verses.kjv: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.modern: The poor You will always have with You, but You will not always have Me.

verses.kjv: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.modern: When she poured this perfume on My body, she did it to prepare Me for burial.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.modern: Truly I tell You, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her."

verses.kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.modern: Then one of the twelve — the one called Judas Iscariot — went to the chief priests

verses.kjv: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.modern: and asked, "What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?" They counted out thirty silver coins for him.

verses.kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.modern: From that time on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

verses.kjv: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.modern: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?"

verses.kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.modern: He replied, "Go into the city to a certain man and tell Him, 'The Master says: My time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with My disciples at Your house.'"

verses.kjv: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.modern: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

verses.kjv: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.modern: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the twelve.

verses.kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.modern: While they were eating, He said, "Truly I tell You, one of You will betray Me."

verses.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.modern: They were deeply grieved and began to say to Him one after another, "Surely not I, Lord?"

verses.kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.modern: He answered, "The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.

verses.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.modern: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for Him if He had not been born."

verses.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.modern: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, "Surely not I, Master?" Jesus answered, "You have said it."

verses.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.modern: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to His disciples. He said, "Take and eat; this is My body."

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.modern: Then He took a cup, gave thanks, and offered it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of You.

verses.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.modern: This is My blood of the new testament, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.modern: I tell You, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with You in My Father's kingdom."

verses.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.modern: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.modern: Then Jesus told them, "This very night You will all fall away because of Me. For it is written: 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

verses.kjv: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.modern: But after I am raised, I will go ahead of You into Galilee."

verses.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.modern: Peter declared, "Even if all the others fall away because of You, I never will."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "Truly I tell You, this very night, before the rooster crows, You will deny Me three times."

verses.kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.modern: Peter said, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny You." And all the other disciples said the same.

verses.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.modern: Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He said to them, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."

verses.kjv: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.modern: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him and began to be sorrowful and deeply troubled.

verses.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.modern: He said to them, "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me."

verses.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.modern: Going a little farther, He fell face down and prayed, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will."

verses.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.modern: Then He returned to His disciples and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, "Could you not keep watch with Me for one hour?

verses.kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.modern: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."

verses.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.modern: He went away a second time and prayed, "My Father, if this cup cannot pass away unless I drink it, Your will be done."

verses.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.modern: When He came back, He again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

verses.kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.modern: So He left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

verses.kjv: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.modern: Then He returned to the disciples and said to them, "Are You still sleeping and resting? The hour has come. The Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.kjv: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.modern: Rise! Let us go! My betrayer is approaching."

verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.modern: While He was still speaking, Judas — one of the twelve — arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.

verses.kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.modern: Now the betrayer had arranged a sign with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him."

verses.kjv: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.modern: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Greetings, Master!" and kissed him.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.modern: Jesus replied, "Friend, why have You come?" Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.modern: Then one of Jesus' companions reached out His hand, drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.modern: "Put Your sword back in its place," Jesus said. "For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

verses.kjv: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.modern: Do You think I cannot call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.kjv: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.modern: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?"

verses.kjv: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.modern: At that hour Jesus said to the crowd, "Have You come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as though I were a criminal? Every day I sat in the temple teaching, and You did not arrest Me.

verses.kjv: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.modern: But all this has taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.

verses.kjv: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.modern: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders had assembled.

verses.kjv: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.modern: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He went in and sat with the guards to see how things would turn out.

verses.kjv: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.modern: The chief priests and the whole council looked for false testimony against Jesus so they could put Him to death.

verses.kjv: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.modern: But they found none, even though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

verses.kjv: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.modern: and said, "This fellow declared, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.'"

verses.kjv: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.modern: Then the high priest stood up and said to Him, "Are You not going to answer? What is this testimony these men are bringing against You?"

verses.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.modern: But Jesus was silent. The high priest said to Him, "I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God."

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "You have said it. But I tell You: From now on You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven."

verses.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.modern: Then the high priest tore His clothes and said, "He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look — now You have heard the blasphemy.

verses.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.modern: What do You think?" "He deserves death," they answered.

verses.kjv: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.modern: Then they spit in His face and struck Him with their fists. Others slapped Him

verses.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.modern: and said, "Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?"

verses.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.modern: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant girl came to Him and said, "You also were with Jesus of Galilee."

verses.kjv: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.modern: But He denied it before them all. "I don't know what You are talking about," he said.

verses.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.modern: Then He went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw Him and said to the people there, "This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth."

verses.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.modern: He denied it again, with an oath: "I do not know the man!"

verses.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.modern: After a little while, those standing there came up to Peter and said, "Surely you are one of them — your accent gives you away."

verses.kjv: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.modern: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, "I do not know the man!" Immediately a rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.modern: Then Peter remembered the words Jesus had spoken: "Before the rooster crows, You will deny Me three times." He went outside and wept bitterly.

chapters.summary: Jesus observes the Last Supper with His disciples, institutes the new covenant in His blood, and prays in agony in the Garden of Gethsemane. Judas betrays Him with a kiss, and Jesus is arrested, tried before Caiaphas and the Sanhedrin, and denied three times by Peter.

verses.kjv: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.modern: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and elders of the people made a plan to have Jesus put to death.

verses.kjv: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.modern: They bound Him, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

verses.kjv: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.modern: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, He was filled with remorse and returned the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and elders.

verses.kjv: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
verses.modern: "I have sinned," he said, "for I have betrayed innocent blood." "What is that to us?" they replied. "That is Your responsibility."

verses.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.modern: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.modern: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, "It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money."

verses.kjv: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.modern: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners.

verses.kjv: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.modern: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

verses.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.modern: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: "They took the thirty silver coins, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,

verses.kjv: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.modern: and they used them to buy the potter's field, as the Lord directed me."

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.modern: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked Him, "Are You the king of the Jews?" "You have said so," Jesus replied.

verses.kjv: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.modern: When He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He gave no answer.

verses.kjv: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.modern: Then Pilate asked him, "Don't you hear the testimony they are bringing against You?"

verses.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.modern: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge — to the great amazement of the governor.

verses.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.modern: Now it was the governor's custom at the feast to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

verses.kjv: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.modern: At that time they had a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

verses.kjv: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.modern: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to You: Barabbas, or Jesus Who is called Christ?"

verses.kjv: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.modern: For He knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to Him.

verses.kjv: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.modern: While Pilate was sitting on the judge's seat, his wife sent him a message: "Don't have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of Him."

verses.kjv: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.modern: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

verses.kjv: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.modern: "Which of the two do You want me to release to You?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.

verses.kjv: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.modern: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus Who is called Christ?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.modern: "Why? What crime has He committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
verses.modern: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that a riot was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man's blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"

verses.kjv: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
verses.modern: All the people answered, "His blood is on us and on our children!"

verses.kjv: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.modern: Then He released Barabbas to them. But He had Jesus flogged and handed Him over to be crucified.

verses.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
verses.modern: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around Him.

verses.kjv: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.modern: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.

verses.kjv: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.modern: They twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand. Then they knelt in front of Him and mocked Him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.

verses.kjv: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.modern: They spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head again and again.

verses.kjv: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.modern: After they had mocked Him, they took off the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him.

verses.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.modern: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

verses.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.modern: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").

verses.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
verses.modern: There they offered Jesus wine mixed with gall to drink, but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.

verses.kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.modern: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His clothes by casting lots, to fulfill what the prophet said: "They divided My garments among them and cast lots for My clothing."

verses.kjv: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.modern: And sitting down they kept watch over Him there.

verses.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.modern: Above His head they placed the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.modern: Two criminals were crucified with Him, one on His right and one on His left.

verses.kjv: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.modern: Those who passed by hurled insults at Him, shaking their heads

verses.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.modern: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days — save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!"

verses.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.modern: In the same way the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders mocked Him.

verses.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.modern: "He saved others," they said, "but He can't save Himself! He's the King of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.

verses.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.modern: He trusts in God. Let God rescue Him now if He wants Him — for He said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

verses.kjv: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.modern: In the same way the criminals who were crucified with Him also hurled insults at Him.

verses.kjv: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.modern: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour, darkness came over all the land.

verses.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.modern: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?" — which means, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"

verses.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
verses.modern: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He's calling Elijah."

verses.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.modern: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

verses.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.modern: The rest said, "Leave Him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes to save him."

verses.kjv: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.modern: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He gave up His spirit.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.modern: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and the rocks split.

verses.kjv: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.modern: The tombs broke open and many bodies of holy people who had died were raised to life.

verses.kjv: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.modern: They came out of the tombs after Jesus' resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

verses.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.modern: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, "Surely He was the Son of God!"

verses.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.modern: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for His needs.

verses.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
verses.modern: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

verses.kjv: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.modern: As evening approached, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus, came.

verses.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.modern: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

verses.kjv: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.modern: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

verses.kjv: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.modern: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a large stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

verses.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.modern: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

verses.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.modern: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate.

verses.kjv: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.modern: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while He was still alive that deceiver said, 'After three days I will rise again.'

verses.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.modern: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."

verses.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
verses.modern: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."

verses.kjv: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.modern: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and setting the guard.

chapters.summary: Judas, filled with remorse, returns the thirty pieces of silver and hangs himself. Jesus is tried before Pontius Pilate, scourged, mocked by the soldiers, and crucified at Golgotha. He cries out to God, gives up His spirit, and is buried in the tomb of Joseph of Arimathaea.

verses.kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.modern: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.modern: There was a great earthquake. An angel of the Lord came down from heaven, rolled back the stone, and sat on it.

verses.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.modern: His face was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

verses.kjv: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
verses.modern: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

verses.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.modern: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that You are looking for Jesus, Who was crucified.

verses.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.modern: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said. Come and see the place where He lay.

verses.kjv: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.modern: Then go quickly and tell His disciples: 'He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of You into Galilee. There You will see Him.' Now I have told You."

verses.kjv: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.modern: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell His disciples.

verses.kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.modern: Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," He said. They came to Him, clasped His feet, and worshiped Him.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.modern: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me."

verses.kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.modern: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

verses.kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.modern: When the chief priests met with the elders and made a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money

verses.kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.modern: and told them, "You are to say, 'His disciples came during the night and stole Him away while we were asleep.'

verses.kjv: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.modern: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy Him and keep You out of trouble."

verses.kjv: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.modern: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely spread among the Jews to this day.

verses.kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.modern: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

verses.kjv: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.modern: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some doubted.

verses.kjv: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.modern: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

verses.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.modern: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Ghost,

verses.kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.modern: teaching them to obey everything I have commanded You. And surely I am with You always, to the very end of the world."

chapters.summary: An angel rolls away the stone from the tomb and announces to Mary Magdalene and the other Mary that Jesus has risen from the dead. The risen Jesus appears to the women and later to the eleven disciples in Galilee, where He commissions them to go and make disciples of all nations.
